qualification.details: Young Professional-II: Postgraduate degree in Fruit Science / Horticulture / Genetics & Plant Breeding / Seed Science & Technology/ Biotechnology / allied disciplines of Life Sciences. Experience in hybridization and seed production of papaya, molecular breeding, knowledge in computer applications, data collection & handling, and statistical analysis. Young Professional-II: Postgraduate degree in Fruit Science / Horticulture / Soil Science/ Agronomy. Experience in fruit crops for fruit quality and biochemical analysis, yield assessment, knowledge of computer applications, data collection & handling, and statistical analysis. Young Professional-I: Graduate with at least 60% marks in relevant Agricultural Sciences / Horticulture/ Biotechnology. Experience in plant tissue culture/ molecular biology/ genomics laboratory work, crop data recording and basic statistical analysis.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the ICAR Indian Agricultural Research Institute (ICAR IARI), New Delhi for contractual research positions.

faq.question: Q2. What posts are available under ICAR IARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts are Young Professional-II and Young Professional-I under research projects in New Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available across different Young Professional positions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 12 October 2026 by 5:30 PM.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the shortlisted candidates is scheduled to be held on 15 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for ICAR IARI recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must send their filled application form along with supporting documents via email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. What is the educational qualification required for Young Professional-II?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a postgraduate degree in Fruit Science, Horticulture, Genetics & Plant Breeding, Seed Science & Technology, Biotechnology, Soil Science, or Agronomy from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: The salary is consolidated at ₹42,000 per month for Young Professional-II and ₹30,000 per month for Young Professional-I.

faq.question: Q9. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 21 and 45 years of age as on the date of the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for submitting the application form.
